comment: Unsettled: R$ 84'894.-- (Brazilian real) added as AMOUNT since it is a sum with a currency token. Unsettled: Art. 17 EuGVÜ/LugÜ inside a book title had BARE_ARTICLE on Art. 17 although an abbreviation follows; relabelled as STATUTE over the compound abbreviation. 'In Ziffer 7 heisst es': no instrument named after the number, no span. Three LugÜ citations (Art. 5 Nr. 1 [lit. b] LugÜ) were missed by the pre-annotator.
